requirement: Extract entries from an Atom feed with lxml, handling the default XML namespace correctly and never resolving external entities.
skeleton: An Atom namespace map, a LINK_XPATH expression, a FeedError, a frozen Entry dataclass, and parse_feed using a hardened parser, a root tag check, findall and findtext with namespaces, and xpath for the alternate link.
caption: Parsing an Atom feed with lxml using namespace-aware lookups. parse_feed(data) builds an etree.XMLParser with resolve_entities=False and no_network=True, wraps etree.XMLSyntaxError in FeedError, and requires the root tag to be the Clark name of feed in the Atom namespace. For each atom:entry found with a prefix map it reads the stripped title with findtext, the href of the alternate link or the link without rel through an XPath string() expression passed namespaces, and the updated text, raising FeedError when the title or link is empty, and returns frozen Entry dataclasses in document order. The fixture asserts the extracted entries, an empty feed, that un-namespaced or RSS roots raise FeedError, blank titles or edit-only links raise, syntax errors are wrapped, and external entities are not expanded.

plan.intent: Read blog feeds for an aggregator
constraints: Malformed XML raises FeedError wrapping etree.XMLSyntaxError
The root must be feed in the Atom namespace, else FeedError
Entry lookups pass the namespace prefix map
The link is the alternate one or the link without rel
Empty titles or links raise FeedError

rationale.teaches: Map a prefix to the default namespace and pass namespaces= to findall, findtext and xpath, since bare tag names never match namespaced elements.
rationale.why: Bare names silently return no entries, picking the first link grabs edit URLs, and a default parser expands external entities into the output.

ops.docstring: Extract Atom feed entries with namespace-aware XPath in lxml.

ops.source:
class FeedError(Exception):
    """Raised when the document is not a usable Atom feed."""

candidates.why_wrong: Bare entry names never match namespaced elements, so every feed returns no entries.
The first link is used even when it is the edit link rather than the alternate one.
A feed root without the Atom namespace is accepted instead of raising FeedError.
The default parser expands external entities and leaks local file contents into titles.
Titles keep surrounding whitespace and a blank title is accepted as valid.
